Login component calls onLogin callback which sets isAuthenticated to true in App.tsx. The App component renders Login when NOT authenticated, and renders trading terminal when authenticated. No routing system detected - just conditional rendering.
State synchronization mismatch: Login.tsx updates Zustand store but App.tsx uses local useState causing race condition. Terminal doesn't render because local state not updating fast enough.

Fixed App.tsx to use Zustand store directly instead of local state. Removed race condition. Backend should run on port 7999 based on api.ts config. Files modified: App.tsx (5 edits). Backup created at App.tsx.backup-before-terminal-fix

Terminal opening fix completed successfully. Root cause was state sync race condition between local useState and Zustand store. Fixed by using Zustand selectors directly. All tests passed. Documentation created in TERMINAL_OPENING_FIX_REPORT.md
